item.title: South-West Development Commission seeks collaboration with NOUN
item.description: The Managing Director, South- West Development Commission (SWDC), Dr. Charles Diji Akinola and his team have visited the headquarters of the National Open University of Nigeria (NOUN) in Abuja, where they sought a collaborative relationship with the university. item.title: Open Universities must consider diverse learner profiles – Inegbedion
item.description: A senior lecturer at the National Open University of Nigeria (NOUN), Prof. Obhajajie Juliet Inegbedion, has said that open universities in the country must consider diverse learner profiles and adapt pedagogical approaches accordingly.
